items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9f5a7221cf8832db6f2da83028976cea1b1af779/Dise%C3%B1o%20sin%20t%C3%ADtulo.png)

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--18060881a66047ac835561d05342fd047ac3d212/1.png) 
​
Esta competencia tendrá **solo el evento 3x3x3 Menos Movimientos**, y se llevará a cabo en múltiples ubicaciones en América del Sur. ¡Preste atención a la **fecha y zona horaria** de su [ubicación](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCSAC2026#70836-lugares-locations)!
​
Se pueden agregar ubicaciones hasta el **15 de mayo** a las 23:59 UTC, por lo que si aún no hay una ubicación cerca de usted, comuníquese con su [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates#latin-america) local en América del Sur.

------

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODc5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e3bf799ef8ade32ca1b076892fb8907ef8205981/2.png) 
​
Esta competição contará **apenas com a modalidade 3x3x3 Menos Movimentos** e será realizada em vários locais da América do Sul. Preste atenção à **data e fuso horário** da sua [localidade](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCSAC2026#70836-lugares-locations)!
​
Os locais podem ser adicionados até **15 de maio** às 23h59 UTC, portanto, se ainda não houver um local próximo a você, entre em contato com o [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates#latin-america) local na América do Sul.

---

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODgwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--89fe33b4e47263997451d2f790cd9ac7e9de0193/3.png) 
​
This competition will hold **only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event**, and it will be held in multiple locations, across South America. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCSAC2026#70836-lugares-locations)!
​
Locations may be added until the **15th of May** 23:59UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates#latin-america) in South America.
​
---

Welcome to **GAN Manila Speedcubing Open 2025**! This competition features the events 3x3, 5x5, 3x3 One-handed, 3x3 Blindfolded, Megaminx, Clock, and Skewb with 3x3 as the main event.

We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.

This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences. This competition is proudly sponsored by **Learn How To Cube** and **GANCUBE**

items.name: RVA Spring 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1Njg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fb0442b987df250ca8c1fe99619c38d7a573dc42/RichmondSpring26FinalLogo-Photoroom.png)

**This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RVASpring2026#72500-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.**

**Notice of Filming and Photography: Please note that filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used in any format for any purpose worldwide in perpetuity by GANCube, TheCubicle, Ethan's Ohana, Mid-Atlantic Speedcubing, Local Television Networks and their affiliates and representatives. Further, by your presence, you grant permission for your likeness and voice to be included therein without compensation, credit, or other consideration. If you do not wish to be photographed, recorded, or appear under these conditions, you should not enter the event premises.**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Additionally, we recommend you attend the Newcomer Tutorial at the beginning of the Competition.

This competition is being held in the Mid-Atlantic Region (DC, DE, MD, NJ, NY, PA, VA, WV). See the regions on [CubingUSA's website](https://cubingusa.org/regional).
